landing.communityText: News, events and notices from your community, and matrimony for those who choose it.
landing.directoryText: Find relatives and community members by name, village or city.
landing.lead: LadWani brings your family tree, your community's members and its news together in one place, for every village.
landing.servicesText: Book community halls and services, and pay family fees and donations online.
landing.title: Your family's story, kept with your community
landing.treeText: Record your family across generations, with spouses and those no longer with us.
landing.trust1: LadWani keeps its own accounts and its own database, apart from every other bkesari project.
landing.trust2: We follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and ask only for what is needed.
landing.trust3: You choose who sees your mobile number, income and matrimony details.
landing.trust4: You can ask for a copy of your data, or for it to be deleted.
